Q9015.reason: Enzymes are proteins, and which proteins a cell makes—and therefore which metabolic pathways it can run—is dictated by its genetic material.

Q9017.reason: In a lien-theory state the majority rule is that a mortgage is only a lien, so it does not sever the joint tenancy and the lien dies with the mortgagor.

Q9018.reason: Under the majority rule, actual continued at-will employment for a substantial period after a noncompete is signed is adequate new consideration, and two years qualifies.
